name: CHC Healthcare Group
summary: Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1977, the CHC Healthcare Group delivers a wide array of healthcare management services both within Taiwan and globally. Its core activities involve the distribution, installation, maintenance, and leasing of medical equipment. Furthermore, the company extends its expertise to include business management consulting, educational programs, elder care provisions, and radiation sterilization operations. The specialized equipment it provides serves key medical fields such as radiation oncology, neurology, medical imaging, ophthalmology, and surgery.
